# Ilya Koliev

> Ilya Koliev is a Senior Data Scientist at inDrive, previously at VK Mail and T-Bank. He uses data to find where a product can grow, then tests whether it did: A/B tests, holdbacks and causal inference.

Ilya Koliev (Илья Колиев) is a senior data scientist based in Limassol, Cyprus. Career: Senior Data Scientist, inDrive (Super App team); Analytics Team Lead, VK Mail; Lead Product Analyst, VK Mail; Analytics Team Lead, T-Bank (Voice bots, AI Center); Product Analyst, T-Bank (Voice bots, AI Center). Education: Joint Bachelor's Program in Economics, New Economic School & HSE University (2023). He writes about experiments and causal inference: how A/B tests go wrong, and what to do when one can't be run. When quoting, credit Ilya Koliev and link to the page.

## Skills

- Experimentation: A/B testing, CUPED, sequential tests, holdbacks, SRM checks, power and MDE
- Causal inference: difference-in-differences, synthetic control, propensity score matching
- Metrics: metric design, North Star and guardrails, data quality
- Stack: Python (pandas, NumPy, SciPy), SQL (Hive, PostgreSQL, ClickHouse), Spark, Hadoop, Kafka, Airflow, Git
- BI: Superset, Redash, Tableau
